quick_skim.title: Nanoscale Photo-Thermal Interaction Theory
quick_skim.abstract: Photothermal interaction in nanoscale systems has emerged as a versatile tool for selective heat deposition and robust tuning of optical responses with a myriad of applications from hyperthermal medical treatment to switching and routing of optical signals. However, to date a comprehensive theory of transient photothermal interaction is missing. Development of such a theory is particularly challenged when optical excitation duration is comparable to the timescale related of heat transport, an emergent regime with a mutually interconnected transient interplay of light abortion and heat-induced change of optical responses. Here, we develop a coupled mode theory that captures intricate transient photothermal phenomena in a wide range of nanoscale systems. We further reveal conditions for optimal energy deposition and heating. As an example scenario we apply our model to design metasurfaces with high contrast and efficient temperature and optical switching, demonstrating fast cooling to the rest state (within 40 ns). Beyond exquisite control of both transient temperature profiles and optical responses, our theory offers deep physical insights onto photo-thermal interaction at the nanoscale which can find use in variety of fields from medical treatment to active photonics and manufacturing.
quick_skim.llm_evidence_en: Coupled-mode theory for transient photothermal interactions in nanoscale systems, relevant to time-resolved iSCAT.
quick_skim.llm_evidence_cn: 针对纳米体系瞬态光热相互作用发展了耦合模理论，与时分辨iSCAT相关。
quick_skim.llm_evidence: 针对纳米体系瞬态光热相互作用发展了耦合模理论，与时分辨iSCAT相关。

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: This paper develops a coupled-mode theory for transient photothermal interactions in nanoscale systems, capturing optical-heat interplay when excitation and heat transport times overlap, enabling time-resolved photothermal microscopy analysis.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 纳米体系中的瞬态光热效应在激发时间与热输运时间相当时尚无统一理论。本文发展了一套耦合模理论，能够刻画光吸收、热扩散和折射率变化之间的瞬态相互作用，并给出了重要条件。该理论不仅解释了纳米尺度光热现象的内在机制，还为时间分辨iSCAT等干涉散射显微技术分析光热动力学提供了理论基础。这项工作对理解材料在超短激光激发下的响应具有重要意义。
quick_skim.llm_tldr: 纳米体系中的瞬态光热效应在激发时间与热输运时间相当时尚无统一理论。本文发展了一套耦合模理论，能够刻画光吸收、热扩散和折射率变化之间的瞬态相互作用，并给出了重要条件。该理论不仅解释了纳米尺度光热现象的内在机制，还为时间分辨iSCAT等干涉散射显微技术分析光热动力学提供了理论基础。这项工作对理解材料在超短激光激发下的响应具有重要意义。

quick_skim.title: Asymptotic Efficiency of the Global Maximum-Likelihood Estimator in Multi-Emitter Localization Microscopy
quick_skim.abstract: We realize the GML estimator by an expectation-maximization algorithm initialized near the true positions and verify the theory by simulation.
quick_skim.llm_evidence_en: Global maximum-likelihood estimator for multi-emitter localization, applicable to iSCAT super-resolution particle tracking.
quick_skim.llm_evidence_cn: 多发射器定位中的全局最大似然估计，可用于iSCAT超分辨粒子追踪。
quick_skim.llm_evidence: 多发射器定位中的全局最大似然估计，可用于iSCAT超分辨粒子追踪。
quick_skim.canonical_evidence: 多发射器定位中的全局最大似然估计，可用于iSCAT超分辨粒子追踪。
quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: This paper analyzes the asymptotic efficiency of the global maximum-likelihood estimator for multi-emitter localization, implements it via expectation-maximization, and verifies by simulation, offering a principled framework for precise localization in scattering-based microscopy.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 多发射器定位显微镜中，常规局部估计方法无法达到最优估计精度。本文系统分析了全局最大似然估计（GML）的渐近效率，借助期望最大化算法进行实现，并通过仿真验证了其理论优势。该方法在重叠信号条件下仍能接近信息论极限，可推广至iSCAT等干涉散射显微镜的纳米粒子高精度定位，为超分辨成像提供了坚实的统计基础。
quick_skim.llm_tldr: 多发射器定位显微镜中，常规局部估计方法无法达到最优估计精度。本文系统分析了全局最大似然估计（GML）的渐近效率，借助期望最大化算法进行实现，并通过仿真验证了其理论优势。该方法在重叠信号条件下仍能接近信息论极限，可推广至iSCAT等干涉散射显微镜的纳米粒子高精度定位，为超分辨成像提供了坚实的统计基础。
